title: Google Earth Pro 7.3.7.1327 package-derived capability baseline

source.description: Static, non-executing inspection of the user's exact Google Earth Pro 7.3.7.1327 RPM and DEB, cross-checked against official Google Earth help and release notes. Proprietary package bytes are not vendored.

expectedOutcomes.assertion: Parity requires a navigable global 3D scene with attributed imagery, terrain, atmosphere, buildings, trees, and declared interaction/performance limits.
Parity requires a durable Places tree plus KML/KMZ/gx authoring and field-level round-trip evidence for all advertised feature semantics.
Parity requires truthful acquisition-aware historical imagery, time-of-day sunlight, and a governed immersive panorama experience.
Parity requires operation-specific spreadsheet, GIS vector/raster, GeoJSON, GPS, styling, regionation, and export evidence without silent loss.
Parity requires saved 2D/3D measurements, elevation profiles, and reproducible viewshed/line-of-sight results with numerical tolerances.
Parity requires deterministic tour recording/playback, gx:Tour interchange, narration, and bounded cancellable movie encoding.
Parity requires annotated high-resolution image and print export with reproducible scene, layout, attribution, legend, scale, and selected-place content.
Parity requires place/address/coordinate/plus-code search, fly-to navigation, hierarchical Places/Layers, saved views, and accessible input behavior.
Parity requires bounded secure NetworkLink/region/LOD refresh, overlay semantics, WMS, and large regionated content interoperability.
A full product parity claim includes the terrain-aware aircraft, HUD, keyboard/joystick, reset, safety, and performance contract shipped in 7.3.7.1327.
